title: KEEL POLAR ICE (Hyperpop × Future Bass) [160]
style: hyperpop meets future bass, 160 BPM with half-time trap drum feel, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), trilingual chop weave English + Korean + te reo Maori, glassy detuned supersaws, bright melodic plucks, snappy trap drum kit with crisp claps, sliding sub 808 bass, vocal stutter and gate edits, sparkling bell arpeggios, pitched-up chop walls at +8, grounded male chops at -3, neon-icy bubblegum mood, sidechain pumping pads to kick, festival mainstage 2026 production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro]
(bell arp, soft pad, glassy supersaw swell)
(KEEL... po... lar... ice...)
(cha... ga... wo... cha... ga... wo...)
(ma... ku... ariki... ma... ku...)

[Build]
(trap hi-hat triplet rolls, 808 slides up)
KEEL! PO — LAR! ICE!
CHA — GA — WO! (cold!)
MA — KU — ARIKI! (frost!)
KEEL — CLEAR — GO!
(supersaw riser, snare roll)

[Drop 1]
(half-time trap, glassy chop walls, sub locked)
PO — LAR!
ICE!
COLD — CLEAR!
HOLD — LINE!
(chop stack +8) ne-ne-yes-yes / āe-āe-ne-ne
THREE — THREE — SIX!
G4 — LENS — ON!

[Verse]
(bell pluck solo, vocal-stutter chops trade)
(eottae?) (how is it?) (pehea?)
(joa!) (good!) (pai!)
(kkaekkeut!) (clear!) (mā mā!)
McIVOR HOLDS THE LINE —
ZYNCONTEXT HOLDS THE LOOP —
SONGPAL HEARS THE CALL —
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Breakdown]
(strip to bell arp + pad alone, no drums)
(whispered) keel... polar... ice...
(soft) chagawo... chagawo...
(soft) makuariki... makuariki...
(piano lifts, soft chop)
KEEL... CLEAR...
THREE... THREE... SIX...
(snare roll builds, trap drums return)

[Drop 2]
(double-time trap, full hyperpop chop wall peak)
KEEL — PO — LAR — ICE! (ne ne ne!)
COLD — CLEAR! (joa joa joa!)
MĀ — MĀ! (kkaekkeut! clear!)
KEEL — TAKE — OVER!
G4 — LENS — LOCKED!
THREE — THREE — SIX!
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Outro]
(trap fades, bell arp resolves)
(keel... polar... ice...)
(chagawo... cold...)
(makuariki... mā...)
(KEEL... CLEAR...)
(supersaw lead holds and fades)
